lead.hed: USNI: New Orleans fire burned 11 hours after a confused first response
lead.insight: USNI News, Monday: a newly released command investigation says a single cigarette or vape may have started a storeroom fire on amphibious transport dock USS New Orleans (LPD-18) in August 2025, and key crew failures let the blaze run 11 hours before it was out. The 46-page report is about last year’s fire, not a new underway casualty today.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo · DVIDS 9670518 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · San Antonio-class amphibious transport dock USS New Orleans (LPD-18) patrols the Arabian Sea, April 28, 2026. Caption must say April file photo, not last year’s fire.
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Navy DVIDS still of LPD-18. Same ship as the investigation item. Not Silent Anvil, not Kitsap barracks, not a brand tile.

political.hed: USNI: San Antonio sailors and Marines destroy a suspected narco refueler
political.insight: USNI News, Monday: Marines and sailors launching from USS San Antonio (LPD-17) boarded a vessel suspected as a floating refueling station, then Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere destroyed it. The task force worked with Ecuador. The item is one interdiction, not a theater-wide claim.

political.hed: USNI: Japan’s first Tomahawk destroyer is back in Sasebo
political.insight: USNI News, Monday: JS Chokai (DDG-176) returned Sunday to Sasebo after a year in the United States being fitted to fire Tomahawk cruise missiles. The ship left Yokosuka on Sept. 25, 2025, for San Diego. Arrival home is not a live-fire announcement.

political.hed: USNI: Abraham Lincoln transited Singapore Strait toward Thailand
political.insight: USNI News, Sunday: USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) passed the Singapore Strait Saturday night, heading for a planned Thailand port visit, according to ship spotters. The Navy has not published a next-port release in that item.

tech.hed: EU names ChatGPT a very large search engine under the DSA
tech.insight: European Commission, Monday: ChatGPT is designated a Very Large Online Search Engine. Reddit and Roblox are designated Very Large Online Platforms. The services told Brussels they reach at least 45 million average monthly EU users. They have four months, until January 2027, to meet the extra DSA duties.

tech.hed: PaperCut says two print-server holes are being exploited
tech.insight: PaperCut’s Aug. 27 urgent advisory and Rapid7’s follow-up: CVE-2026-81578 is an authentication bypass and CVE-2026-82078 is unsafe class loading in the database connector. Rapid7 writes both were added to CISA’s known-exploited list on Aug. 31. Patch the vendor bulletin; do not leave print consoles on the open internet.

tech.hed: Defense News: Pentagon framework deals aim to surge Patriot and THAAD
tech.insight: Defense News, Monday: framework agreements with Lockheed Martin and General Dynamics include tripling Patriot production and quadrupling THAAD interceptor output. A framework is a production path, not missiles on the ramp tonight.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: the Constitution is not as godless as the critics say
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Monday: a book review argues the American Constitution is not as “godless” as postliberal critics claim, and that the people still have to sustain the spiritual capital that makes the document work.
